title: Print Numbers
description: Write a function that prints the numbers 1 through n, each on its own line. Use the built-in IO effect's print operation. Use a pure helper to format each number as a string. The main function should have effects(<IO>) and use a recursive loop helper via a where block.
description_neutral: Print the numbers 1 through n, each on its own line.
notes: Tests the built-in IO effect, to_string discovery, and a recursive IO loop. The agent must use a where block for the loop. The format_number helper must be pure.
